nodes.text: Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV)  is NOT a new virus and was first identified in 2001 as per @MoHFW_INDIA and @TNDPHPM it surges in winter months. Infections are mild, self-limiting, and manageable with rest and hydration and symptomatic care by experts.
